jobs.title: Computational Biology Intern - Single Cell
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a summer intern to work on single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics in oncology.

  • Graduate students (MS or PhD) currently enrolled are eligible.
  • Experience with Seurat or scanpy preferred, not required.
  • Housing stipend provided for interns relocating more than 50 miles.

Mentored by the Computational Oncology group. Interns present at our internal summer symposium.
